description.short: Read Copilot balances, policies and group users with authorized name resolution.
description.full: Experimental read-only plugin with an integrated credit-management skill and an OAuth-protected Azure MCP connector. Six tools read tenant balances, spending policies, assigned groups, group users, per-user service balances and targeted basic user profiles through delegated Microsoft Graph. Missing names/UPNs can be read by user GUID with User.ReadBasic.All consent according to tenant policy; existing group and balance scopes do not change. The cost-management API is Preview/beta. Membership may lag recent changes and does not prove policy enforcement. Missing quantities, profile failures and partial pagination remain explicit. No write operations. Requires the matching backend release; actual profile access must be tested in Cowork.

agentConnectors.description: Read balances, policies, assigned groups, group users and targeted basic user profiles as the caller. Profile names require User.ReadBasic.All separately from roster Assignment/GroupMember.ReadBasic and balance UserData consent. Experimental and read-only.
